n-solana-privacy-coins.summary: Coins named for confidential, shielded transfers on Solana. Helius posted on X on 2026-11-10 at 14:28 UTC "Introducing Solana Privacy Rings", describing programmable onchain environments for encrypting money and markets, "now live on mainnet", with private balances and private transfers (e4:0); Crossmint posted on 2026-11-17 that a confidential onramp powered by Helius Privacy Rings is live (e3:1). Zolana's account posted on 2026-11-20 at 03:51 UTC "Private is now native", describing Zolana as an independent open-source Layer 1 with shielded payments and a devnet (e3:6); posts of 2026-11-22 say Helius's privacy code refers to Zolana, which is their claim. Members: Confidential Cat (hCAT, LaunchLab), whose description reads "Helius is bringing confidential transactions to Solana"; Confidential Cat (cCAT, Pump.fun); Zolana (ZOL, Pump.fun), described as "an independent Layer 1 where privacy is native to the protocol"; and Zolana (ZOL, LaunchLab). Dates from Codex: the Pump.fun Zolana was created on 2026-11-20 at 03:51 UTC, the minute of Zolana's post; the LaunchLab Zolana on 2026-11-22 at 22:31 UTC, cCAT at 23:00 UTC and hCAT on 2026-11-23 at 02:47 UTC, all after Helius's launch post. Posts argue over which ticker is the right one. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Helius, Zolana or Crossmint. Measured: four coins across all their pools.
